player_prompt.intro:
Sida ri Player {player_id} makkalu' permainan Pig Dice.

Pappaseng:
- Ri giliranta, kau bisa '[roll]' atawa '[hold]'
- Roll 2-6: Tambahka ri total giliranta
- Roll 1: Kale giliranta total sibawa tammati giliranta
- Hold: Tambahka total giliranta ri skormu sibawa tammati giliranta
- Sipolo ri {winning_score} poin menang

Ri giliranta, kau bisa ngiwa skor makki sibawa total giliranta.
Tanggapi ri '[roll]' untu' nggelinding dadu atawa '[hold]' untu' bank poinmu.

board.current_total_scores: Total skor iya makkokkoe: {scores} total giliranmu iyanaritu {turn_total}.

outcome.winner_by_turn_limit: Player {winner_id} menang ri skor lebbi tinggi ri batas giliranta ({scores})
outcome.winner_by_score: Player {winner_id} menang ri mencapai skor target {winning_score}!
outcome.draw: Watang giliranna pura ri cappu na sininna tau maccule e mappunai skor pappada: {scores}
